verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents a Hosted Payment Page that accepts multiple payment methods through a single integration, and a Drop-in Element that adapts its fields to the payment method and country. It also cites 160+ local payment methods (via invoices and payment links), local-method enablement through the Multi-Currency Pricing API, and redirect-flow integration guidance. However, none of the evidence names Apple Pay, Google Pay or BNPL specifically. missing for 10: explicit documentation of Apple Pay and Google Pay wallet support, BNPL methods, named bank-redirect methods in the checkout integration, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
